sophia_k: hypothesis list in-thread (for RCA tracking):
- H1: accidental HPA clamp in prod (config error) prevented scaling to meet spike.
- H2: reserved capacity for Dedicated customers left insufficient free GPUs for autoscale.
- H3: new nodepool taint without runtime tolerations blocked scheduling.
- H4: metric adapter staleness caused HPA to lag initially.
- H5: long model warmup (~18-22s) during pod startup amplified queue backlog.

maria_c: immediate mitigations we can attempt (ranked):
1) roll back prod HPA clamp or raise maxReplicas temporarily
2) patch model-runtime tolerations to accept tainted nodes (quick)
3) divert non-enterprise traffic to us-east-1 (regional fallback)
4) temporarily route to smaller model-variant to reduce per-request GPU pressure
5) reduce continuous batch window to lower tail latency
6) enable graceful reject for lowest tier if needed
